text:
mina: CI red on e2e-gpu-hybrid, shard 42. short-lived pagefaults during warmup. tagging @sam @julie for triage.

ci-bot: Build e2e-gpu-hybrid #527 failed (shard 42). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/build/527/shard/42

sam: on it — can you paste the top of the log (kernel / driver lines)?

mina: sure, excerpt:```
[WARMUP] perf: warmup sequence start
[GPU0] pagefault: invalid read at 0x7ffd3a2c
[CUDA] cuInit: driver version 525.85.12 detected
[MODEL] load: cuda runtime expects 520.61.05 (symbol mismatch)
[ATTN] out-of-memory while allocating 1.2GB in aten::empty
[ERR] runtime abort: kernel launch failed with code 77
```

julie: oof driver mismatch + OOM. the driver bump landed in node canary yesterday?

mina: yes — infra pushed image-gpu:2026-03-16 which includes driver 525.85.12. our e2e matrix pins cuda toolchain at 520 in the test image. no symlink fixup.

diego: driver/kernel mismatch can cause transient pagefaults. Also a small allocator change will amplify frag and surface OOMs. quick check: can you share /proc/driver/nvidia/version output from the failing host?

mina: grabbed from node gpu-node-17:```
NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module 525.85.12 Thu Mar 11 12:22:45 UTC 2026
GCC: 11.3.0
```

sam: thanks. i'm going to requeue the shard to see if it's infra flake or deterministic. @ci-bot rerun job=527 shard=42 reason="triage - repro on same node"

ci-bot: Rerun queued: e2e-gpu-hybrid #527 shard=42 -> queued on gpu-node-17 (note: cache warmed).

ci-bot: Rerun result: FAILURE. New trace:```
[ATTN] allocate KV cache 512MB -> success
[ATTN] attempt alloc 1.2GB -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY (700)
[BACKTRACE] at inference::attention::compute
[LOG] active allocations: [128MB, 256MB, 384MB, 512MB]
```

julie: this is leaning toward fragmentation / allocator change. were any runtime PRs merged recently touching kvcache or allocator?

mina: runtime PR 1023 bumped default kvcache reserve and changed free lists — merged in commit d3f45b2 on Mar 15. test matrix didn't catch it locally.

diego: can you try a local repro on an a100 with --batch-size=1 --kv-reserve=256MB and --num-threads=2? that will help narrow frag vs commit break. If repro, i'll bisect between d3f45b2..e7a9c34.

sam: filing a bisect request and attaching debug tarball now. assigning to @sam for initial bisect. PR range: runtime d3f45b2 -> e7a9c34.

mina: filed: https://tickets.internal.redwood/CI-9234 "e2e-gpu-hybrid: short-lived pagefaults + OOM after kvcache change". debug tarball attached. thanks :thumbsup:

sam: i'll start the bisect tonight. if anyone spots an infra node with mixed driver/toolkit versions, please @me.

mina: also adding a temporary canary: pin node image -> 520.61.05 to see if failures stop. will update ops.

ci-bot: NOTE: pinned node pool gpu-canary to image-gpu:520-pin (rollback) per request from mina.

sam: great. will report back with bisect result or a repro snippet.

diego: if bisect shows runtime regression, pls cc eng-runtime and eng-ml, we'll fast-follow with fix/backout.

mina: thanks team — keeping this thread for updates.
